draft.subject: your client intake role
draft.body:
Hi Martin,

Loved your recent talk at the Law Society on client confidentiality. I also saw Penrose Vale is hiring a client intake assistant to open files and run conflict checks.

We built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture.

Is keeping intake data in-house on your radar?

claims.text: Loved your recent talk at the Law Society on client confidentiality
Penrose Vale is hiring a client intake assistant to open files and run conflict checks
We built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture

evidence.text: Client Intake Assistant. Handle first enquiries from new clients, open files and run ID and conflict checks.
No live chat, online booking or after-hours phone line was found on the website; the Contact page offers a form only.

facts.wording: Built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture (Legal AI).
The Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) warning notice of 17 August 2026 allows client data into AI tools only with contractual, technical and organisational safeguards.
A 17+ person team of engineers, AI specialists and analysts, based in San Jose.

findings.span: Loved your recent talk at the Law Society on client confidentiality
